notes: Paper (arXiv:2102.00379, Dolan/Hiskens/Volkas) derives a NEW stellar-evolution bound ('WD-IFMR') on the ALP-photon coupling g_agamma for keV-MeV mass ALPs using the white dwarf initial-final mass relation from double WD binaries, notably excluding part of the 'cosmological triangle'. The pre-analysis hint of AxionElectron is incorrect: the paper explicitly considers ALPs coupling EXCLUSIVELY to photons (Eq 1.1). No numerical table of the exclusion contour is given; the full limit is presented only in Figures 1 and 15. The emitted points are explicit excluded/sensitive parameter choices quoted in the text: 10 keV ALPs excluded at g=0.794e-10 GeV^-1; 316 keV ALPs at g=3.16e-9 GeV^-1 (IFMR falls outside DWD constraint, beyond HB bound); 630 keV at g=1e-5 GeV^-1 inside the cosmological triangle where the IFMR is shown sensitive. These sparse points approximate the contour shape only; the limit also relaxes at high g_agamma where the ALP decay length falls below the He-burning shell width (~0.007 R_sun). This is an astrophysical (stellar energy-loss) bound, not a DM haloscope, so no local DM density assumed.
